svg.title: Kana Study Hub
svg.desc: Logo for Kana Study Hub, a site for learning Japanese hiragana and katakana: listen, watch the stroke order, and practice writing. A red rounded square holds a white hiragana あ, with a blue corner tab holding the katakana ア.

text.font-family: 'Klee One','Yu Kyokasho','Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN','Hiragino Sans','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif
